 fields=avail.get(dep,set()); expressions=[]

  elif n in ['crash_rate_per_1k_devices','anr_rate_per_1k_devices','app_crash_rate_per_1k']: val=f'cast(0 as {typ})'
  else: val=f'cast(NULL as {typ})'
  expressions.append(f'{val} AS {n}')
 sql='SELECT\n'+',\n'.join(expressions)+f'\nFROM {sch}.{tbl} AS src'
 if 'date_day' in fields and any(c['name']=='date_day' for c in cols): sql+='\nWHERE src.date_day IS NOT NULL'
 pathlib.Path('sql/marts/'+name+'.sql').write_text(sql+'\n')
